## Freed v26.10.801-dev

Keep reader images tied to accepted post data

### Fixes

- The reader can use a newly hydrated first image without HTML while preserving the selected post's author and body and rejecting obsolete replies. [#2196](https://github.com/freed-project/freed/pull/2196)
- Replacing or canceling a search forwards cancellation to Freed Desktop and keeps obsolete results from updating the view. [#2191](https://github.com/freed-project/freed/pull/2191)

### Follow-ups

- The installed cross-post complaint and live media provenance still need verification; the reader change has synthetic regression coverage
- Five synthetic Facebook feed and story sponsored-disclosure cases remain unresolved. Provider extraction, requests and cadence are unchanged
- Future producers that return distinct media require a new provider review. Live provider verification remains pending

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
